target: QEMU AArch64 virt, HVF, one vCPU, PCI storage and VirtIO input
command: ZEAL_TEST_DISK=build/candidate-install-disk.img QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-tothefront
result: pass for setup and one artillery order
checks: Accepted default seed, selected Human for both players and dismissed help.
Rendered the generated map, selected an artillery unit and showed its yellow range.
Plotted an order into an adjacent hex, advanced a phase with Space and returned through Escape to a terminal evaluating 40+2 as 42.
test_change: Wait three seconds after map rendering before using the yellow range baseline; the initial Turn banner uses the same color.
diagnostics: The terminal input harness retried graphical input before confirming the exact launch command. An earlier separate movement investigation used an inaccessible app-private variable and is not counted as a movement check. An older default disk failed its seed prompt; this test uses the newer candidate.
limitations: Broader direct fire, a full match and AI behavior remain unverified. One controlled direct-fire interaction per player passed with the later source overlay, as detailed below.
QEMU result does not establish live UTM or Pi behavior.

movement_followup.method: A disposable candidate-disk copy has reporting-only additions to Human.ZC that choose a legal adjacent move and print the unit grid coordinates before and after. The harness drove the actual mouse-down, drag and mouse-up path. The shipped candidate disk and source remain unchanged.
movement_followup.setup: Extract boot/sources.tar from build/zealos-aarch64-candidate-2026-11-09.iso and run python3 scripts/prepare-tothefront-move-test.py --disk build/candidate-install-disk.img --sources build/tothefront-candidate-sources.tar --output build/tothefront-instrumented-repro.img. Recreated source matched tested fixture byte-for-byte.
movement_followup.command: ZEAL_TEST_DISK=build/tothefront-instrumented.img QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-tothefront-move-diag
checks: Selected artillery and plotted an order, then advanced past the second artillery phase.
The game reported a legal move for unit 0 from grid cell (17,4), with screen drag (163,179) to (163,160).
After mouse input the game reported unit 0 moved from (17,4) to (15,4).
Escape returned to the graphical terminal; 40+2 returned 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
movement_followup.limitations: The fixture changes the game source to report state and select an eligible move; this is not an unmodified-binary movement test. One legal move is covered, not direct fire, AI, a complete match, or live UTM/Pi.

direct_fire_followup.result: pass with source overlay; baseline reproduces player 2 failure
direct_fire_followup.method: A disposable instrumented disk places a live enemy unit in a legal adjacent empty cell for each side, clears old visibility flags and reports selected units and fire result. Actual selection, visibility recalculation and firing use the game mouse-input path.
direct_fire_followup.baseline: Player 0 fired; player 1 reported fired=0 with visibility flags 0,1, showing the original condition used the other player's flag.
direct_fire_followup.fix: The Human AI source overlay uses target->vis[cur_player] in the direct-fire test. The new source bundle differs from the earlier candidate bundle only in this check.
direct_fire_followup.fixed_result: Both player 0 and player 1 fired, followed by Escape, terminal 40+2 = 42 and zstatus failed=0.
direct_fire_followup.command: ZEAL_TEST_DISK=build/tothefront-direct-fixed.img QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-tothefront-fire-diag
limitations: The controlled fixture relocates opponents and modifies the source for reporting; it does not prove firing in a natural full match.

An uninstrumented source-volume regression was attempted twice: the first could not select overlapping artillery markers; the second exhausted graphical launcher input retries. Neither establishes a game failure or a clean uninstrumented pass.
The earlier candidate ISO does not include this fix; live UTM and Pi remain unverified.
